2.footnotes: [1] i.e., the first ten nights of the lunar month of Dhul-Hijjah.

3.translation: and the even and the odd[2],

4.translation: and by the night when it comes,

5.translation: are these oaths not sufficient for those who have sense?

6.translation: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād

7.translation: of Iram[3], who were people of great stature,
7.footnotes: [3] Iram: an ancient tribe; or a well-known tribe in Yemen; or the grandfather of the people of ‘Aad, etc. Prophet Hūd was sent to the people of ‘Aad.

8.translation: the like of whom had never been created in the land;

9.translation: and Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the Valley;

10.translation: and the mighty and powerful[4] Pharaoh?
10.footnotes: [4] Or the owner of the stakes by which he used to torture people.

11.translation: All of them transgressed in the land,

13.translation: so your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

14.translation: Indeed, your Lord is ever vigilant.

15.translation: As for man, when he is tested by his Lord by honoring him and bestowing blessings upon him, he says, “My Lord has [deservedly] honored me[5]!”
15.footnotes: [5] Instead of being grateful, he is proud, attributing the favor to his own merit.

16.translation: But when he is tested by restricting his provision, he says, “My Lord has [undeservedly] humiliated me!”

17.translation: No indeed[6]! You are not kind to the orphan,
17.footnotes: [6] It is not as you think. Allah puts people to test through prosperity and hardship and rewards their gratitude and patience in the Hereafter.

18.translation: nor do you urge one another to feed the needy,

19.translation: and you greedily consume the entire inheritance[7],

21.translation: No indeed! When the earth is crushed over and over,

22.translation: and your Lord comes[8] with the angels, rank after rank,

23.translation: and Hell is brought near on that Day – this is when man will understand, but what is the use of that understanding?

24.translation: He will say, “Would that I had sent forth something for my [eternal] life!”

25.translation: None can punish as He punishes on that Day,

26.translation: and none can bind as He binds.

27.translation: [It will be said to the believer,] “O the tranquil soul!

28.translation: Return to your Lord, well pleased and pleasing [to Him].
